description: keel hooks: the git guard (denies force-push, protected-branch deletion on the remote, reset --hard, clean -f, whole-tree discards, filter-branch, and filter-repo, and allows a lease onto a named branch that is not protected; AI attribution trailers only with KEEL_BLOCK_AI_TRAILERS=1) and the lead reminder that keeps the keel:lead method sticky across turns, and the correct reminder that sends a prompt reading as a correction through the correct skill, and the think hooks that make every turn dig before answering and review once before it ends, and the qmd hooks that ensure the memory search daemon is up and warn when a turn searched without querying it.
